digest.component_or_area: binding store persistence and selective publication
propositions: Repository delegation must preserve the boundary between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without blurring ownership or partial-state semantics.
Selective publication must stage only the existing five allowlisted bridge-state files and never publish repository checkpoints independently.
Unchanged passes must create no commit, and GET rotation and retired-first failure cases must preserve pre-extraction publication and recovery floors.
ADR 0099 must durably document repository versus publication ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, rollback strategy, and explicit no-journal and no-format-migration decisions.
Regressions must guard the five-file allowlist, unchanged-pass behavior, rotation floor, and retired-first publication semantics through existing held-out selective-publication suites.
